source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A fairly ordinary finding in this situation that would not typically call for urgent further evaluation","B":"An unrelated musculoskeletal condition, since fever and altered mental status are thought to commonly stem from this simpler cause","C":"Encephalitis, inflammation of the brain tissue itself, requiring urgent evaluation and treatment","D":"A simple tension headache, a diagnosis that would not fully account for the seizures and altered mental status described"}}
source_row.rationale: Fever, headache, altered mental status, and new-onset seizures suggest encephalitis, inflammation of the brain tissue itself (distinct from meningitis, which primarily involves the meninges), requiring urgent evaluation and treatment given the risk of serious neurological complications.
source_row.source_name: Clinical Neuroinfectious Disease References — Encephalitis Recognition
